# VoiceClaw R0 contract fixtures

These files are the portable `nemoclaw-voice-r0/1` fixture bundle from
[NemoClaw issue #11747](https://github.com/NVIDIA/NemoClaw/issues/11747).

`fixtures.json`, `fixture_server.py`, and `test_fixture.py` are copied byte-for-byte from revision 1.
The fixture JSON SHA-256 is
`20132310c2f14dd927b0ac50e30d5176a9e3c99b83d5890c9cf581e2320d3442`.

The Python server is synthetic. It does not prove native-agent readiness or live deployment behavior.
